name: A specialization slot keeps its purchased talent button across a round trip (#9808)
contract: #9808 reports that switching between specialization slots silently drops action bar buttons from the
slot being switched to, and that buttons placed on a slot after switching into it never reach that
slot's stored record. Reproduces with two Incineration (spec 38) talents (CharacterAdvancement.dbc
ClassType 26 Tab 62): entry 5187 rank 1 grants 520485 on slot I, entry 6985 rank 1 grants 800791 on
slot II. Buy each talent and bind it to button 2 on its own slot, then round-trip slot I -> slot II ->
slot I -> slot II and assert each slot's bound button survives every switch away and back, including
the button placed on slot II immediately after switching into it for the first time.
AscensionCompat.cpp's SwitchSlot snapshots the outgoing slot's live bar (LiveSlot) before touching talents
and stores it (StoreSlot) after the target slot's own entries are already re-applied (ApplyKnownEntriesUpload
completes synchronously, including the SetTalentRank diff that regrants the incoming slot's talents,
before addActionButton validates HasSpell on the incoming bar), so a clean round trip is expected to
keep both buttons and both talents.

steps.label: SETUP: 520485 is known on slot I
Switch to slot II (first time, blank)
Choose Incineration for slot II too
SETUP: 800791 is known on slot II
Bind 800791 right after switching into the newly opened slot II
DISCRIMINATING: slot I's own button (520485) survives the round trip
520485 is known again on slot I
Switch to slot II a second time
DISCRIMINATING: the button placed right after the first switch into slot II (800791) survived leaving and returning
800791 is still known on the second visit to slot II
